findings.title: raw MODEL effect API bypasses Guard
findings.fact: RuntimeModelAccessScope exposes frame/beginSession/effectProvider; RuntimeModelEffectBindingResult exposes operationPort; proofless ResolvedProtectedReadAccess/WriteAccess factories permit raw MODEL READ/WRITE without ExactModelAccessGuard.

findings.title: same-plan cross-context permission reuse
findings.fact: ProductionCompositionCoordinator.belongsToCapturedContext uses RuntimeBindingPlan.equals; RuntimeBindingPlan equality is structural only and RuntimeModelProvenance carries no exact EngineContext identity.
